Features

  • Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain

    When you Dash,  Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down.

  • Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain

    You have become an expert at moving through the wilderness.  Difficult Terrain no longer slows you down.

  • Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack

    If you move after making a melee attack, you don't provoke Opportunity Attacks from your target.

  • Extra Attack

    Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack.

  • Mobile

    Your movement speed increases by 3m.

  • Opportunity Attack

    Attack an enemy moving out of reach.

Cashguard Artillerist Triava is a human member of the Cashguard who can be found at The Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate. She is in the off-limits area on the main floor, behind the clerks.
